title: Kissed Silky Croatian Shrimp Risotto
description: A smoky, silky risotto featuring sweet shrimp, pickled cucumber, and a hint of sugar, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in arborio rice, coating grains with oil, and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in white wine, stirring until liquid is almost absorbed.
Add one cup of hot fish stock, stirring constantly; when liquid is absorbed, add another cup; repeat until rice reaches al dente texture, about 18 minutes total.
In a separate pan, cook shrimp in butter, smoked paprika, caster sugar, and a splash of lemon juice until pink, about 3-4 minutes.
Fold cooked shrimp into the risotto, stir to combine.
Stir in diced pickled cucumber for a bright contrast.
Season risotto with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnish with optional parsley if desired.
